Celebrate the holidays in grand style with this 8ft Pre-lit Resin Candy Cane Nutcracker. Crafted from durable polyresin and accented with 42 multicolour LED lights, it plays 8 classic holiday tunes to add festive charm to any space. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, it includes a removable staff, AC adapter, and easy assembly. The rich hand-painted finish and oversized design make it a standout holiday centerpiece. Built to last, this nutcracker combines tradition with modern functionality.
Oversized 8-Foot Holiday Showpiece – Create a magical Christmas display with this stunning 8ft Candy Cane Nutcracker. Designed to impress both day and night, the rich hand-painted detailing and grand scale make it the ultimate festive focal point for homes, gardens, shops, entrances and holiday events.
Pre-Lit with 42 Multicolour LED Lights – Comes fully pre-lit with 42 vibrant LEDs that bring bold brilliance and festive colour to your décor. Bright, energy efficient LED lighting ensures long lasting seasonal illumination with minimal maintenance.
Plays 8 Classic Christmas Melodies – Built-in sound function plays 8 popular holiday tunes to add warmth, nostalgia and family joy to your Christmas experience. Simply plug in and enjoy a fully immersive seasonal atmosphere.
Indoor & Outdoor Safe Construction – Made from weather resistant polyresin/stone material suitable for both interior and exterior holiday decorating. Strong, durable and built to withstand seasonal conditions while maintaining colour & detail year after year.
Easy Set Up & Complete With Accessories – Includes removable candy cane staff, 120V AC adapter and long 32 ft (10 m) power cord for flexible placement. Ideal for living rooms, porches, storefronts, lobbies, gardens, malls and party displays.
Guarantee - 1 year

5056095713177.sourceDescription:
Fill your home with festive colour with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Its traditional shape and realistic mixed foliage create a beautiful backdrop for treasured ornaments, while dual multi colour and warm white LED lights bring a cheerful sparkle to the branches. Available in heights, 6ft, 7ft and 10ft.

This Fraser Fir makes a welcoming focal point for Christmas celebrations. A blend of PE tips and PVC tips gives the tree texture and fullness, ready to dress with family favourites or a fresh decorating theme.

With the lights already fitted, you can spend more time enjoying the decorating. Choose from 9 multifunction light settings, including a steady glow, playful twinkle and gentle slow fade, to set the mood for cosy evenings or festive gatherings. The LEDs are mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and a folding metal stand is included. Take a little time to spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to reveal the tree's full shape, then add your decorations for a personal finishing touch.

Features:
 Light functions: 9 multi function settings
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

For the best finish, gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's full shape before decorating.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 135cm
Tip count: 1295 (400 PE and 895 PVC)
Lights: 500 multi colour LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

The artificial Christmas tree features a full bodied snow flocked design with one thousand and twenty lush green branches. This creates a bold and beautiful silhouette that stands out as a centrepiece in your home. The moulded tips mimic real branches for a realistic appearance.

Pre-attached hinges allow for quick and easy setup without complex tools. The branches drop into place naturally, requiring only roughly fifteen minutes to shape fully. The pre-moulded structure ensures the branches always maintain their intended form after assembly.

Flame-retardant materials provide extra safety for leaves and flocking within family homes. This feature offers peace of mind during festive celebrations when lights or candles are present. The tree remains safe for indoor use while maintaining its decorative appeal throughout the season.

The folding metal base supports the tree securely, keeping it standing firmly in place. This sturdy foundation prevents tipping and ensures stability for heavy ornaments. When the season ends, the base folds away easily for convenient storage alongside other holiday decorations.

Measuring one hundred and fifty centimetres tall and one hundred and seven centimetres wide, this tree fits well in standard living spaces. The compact dimensions allow it to serve as an ideal festive ornament for apartments or smaller rooms. Its green plastic construction ensures durability.

Pre-attached hinges allow quick assembly in roughly fifteen minutes without complex tools.
Flame-retardant materials provide extra safety for leaves and flocking within family homes.
Folding metal base supports the tree securely and folds away easily for convenient storage.
Guarantee - 1 month

7906816232877.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Realistic Birch Appearance: Featuring a bark-textured trunk and multiple flexible branches, this artificial silver birch tree creates a natural look. Shape the branches to suit your space and preferred style.
48 Warm White LED Lights: Built-in warm white LED lights provide a soft, cosy glow, creating an inviting atmosphere in the evening. The included 12V power adaptor and 1.8m power cable offer convenient connection to a socket.
Sturdy Decorative Base: The wide square base with a realistic root effect provides stable support while complementing the natural birch tree design.
Flexible Branches: The branches can be shaped and decorated with lightweight ornaments to suit different occasions, including Christmas, Easter and Halloween, or left undecorated for a simple natural look.
Easy Assembly & Care: Simply insert the trunk into the base, tighten and arrange the branches. Designed for indoor use only. Wipe clean with a soft cloth when needed. Made from PVC for everyday decorative use.
 
Specifications
Colour: White
Material: New, PVC, Metal, Plastic
Height: 4 ft/ 180 cm
Base Dimensions: 21 cm x 21 cm
Number of Lights: 48
Net Weight: 1 kg
Rated Input Voltage: 120v/ 60hz
Rated Output Voltage: 12v
Cord Length: 6 ft
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.
High Quality Material: This silver birch tree not only looks good but is also of excellent quality. Made from quality PVC, which is odourless, non-toxic, flame retardant and pet/child friendly, this quality silver birch tree is suitable in any room in your home. Clean, when necessary, with a cloth.
Safe to Use: The pre-lit silver birch tree is designed with safety in mind, and, with the assistance of the power adaptor, the tree has a low output voltage of 12v. The adaptor has a power cord of 1.8m ensuring it is within reach of a plug socket wherever it is positioned.
Life like Appearance: This realistic silver birch tree has a bark textured trunk with multiple branches that can be shaped to suit. The wide square base, with root effect, ensures the stability of the tree while the 48 warm white lights provide a warm glow after dark, simply plug in and enjoy the warm, festive atmosphere.
Easy Installation: Suitable for indoor use only, the silver birch tree is easy to assemble. Simple place the trunk into the base, tighten and shape as required. The tree can be switched on as soon as you have finished shaping.
Flexible Tree Branches: The realistic silver birch tree has multiple branches that can be shaped and decorated to suit your individual style. Leave bare for the natural look, decorate with lightweight Christmas baubles for Christmas or Easter eggs at Easter. You could also decorate it with spiders and pumpkins for Halloween! This silver birch is an ideal all year decoration.
Guarantee - 1 year
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Pack of 18 red plastic baubles for festive Christmas tree decoration.
Hanging format allows easy placement throughout tree branches.
Durable plastic construction designed for repeated seasonal use.
Classic red colour adds vibrant detail to holiday displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Hanger included

5056463974377.sourceDescription:
Bring festive charm to your outdoor decorations with this Solar Santa and Snowman Garden Light Set. The collection contains four decorative character stakes, including two Santa figures and two Snowmen, allowing you to create a coordinated Christmas arrangement around lawns, garden borders, flower beds and pathways. Each festive character stands above a softly illuminated globe featuring a decorative snowflake pattern, providing a warm seasonal glow as darkness falls. The separate solar panel collects energy from available daylight and powers the lights automatically in lower-light conditions when the system is correctly activated and sufficiently charged. This cable-free solar design avoids the need for a nearby mains socket, making it practical for suitable garden locations. Assembly is straightforward using the supplied connecting poles and pointed ground stakes, which insert into suitable soil. Measuring approximately 44cm high per character stake, with a 25cm solar panel stake, the decorations provide an attractive festive feature without taking up excessive space. Ideal for Christmas entrances, garden paths and outdoor seasonal displays.
COMPLETE FOUR-PIECE CHRISTMAS DISPLAY: Decorate your outdoor space with two cheerful Santa figures and two Snowman characters, providing a balanced festive arrangement for garden pathways, flower beds, lawns and entrance borders.
SOFTLY ILLUMINATED SNOWFLAKE DESIGN: Each character is positioned above a decorative glowing globe with snowflake detailing, creating a welcoming seasonal appearance that complements Christmas garden ornaments and outdoor festive arrangements.
CHARGES NATURALLY DURING DAYLIGHT: Separate solar panel gathers energy from available sunlight and supports automatic illumination after dark when the lights are switched on, providing decorative lighting without the need for mains wiring.
STRAIGHTFORWARD OUTDOOR ASSEMBLY: Pointed ground spikes and connecting pole sections allow the lights to be assembled and inserted into suitable soil, making it convenient to position the characters along paths or amongst planted garden areas.
COMPACT YET NOTICEABLE DIMENSIONS: Individual character stakes stand approximately 44cm high, complemented by a separate solar panel stake measuring around 25cm, creating a practical seasonal display for different outdoor garden spaces.

5052532155777.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Acrylic. Product measurements: length 7 cm, width 7 cm, height 7 cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Pack of 12 festive acrylic ornaments featuring a classic Father Christmas motif for holiday displays.
Compact 7cm cube design allows for versatile placement on mantels, shelves, or in coordinated groupings.
Durable acrylic construction ensures the decorations maintain their shape and finish throughout the season.
Versatile decorative accessory that adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to any home Christmas display.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 12 x Christmas decorations

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5029936976277.sourceDescription:
Bring the magic of Christmas into your home with this beautifully designed The Snowman 29cm Water Lantern. Perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere, this charming decoration combines timeless design with modern features to make your seasonal décor truly shine. The lantern features a delightful Snowman scene illuminated by colour-changing LED lights, gently swirling water, and sparkling glitter that creates a snow globe effect, making it a stunning centrepiece for any room. Measuring 29cm tall, the lantern is perfectly sized for display on shelves, sideboards, windowsills, or as part of a festive table arrangement. Designed exclusively for indoor use, it is a versatile piece that blends seamlessly with both traditional and modern Christmas themes. The built-in timer function ensures convenience and energy efficiency, automatically lighting up for 6 hours before switching off for 18 hours, ready to sparkle again the next evening without any need to reset. This water lantern offers a dual power option, giving you the flexibility to run it either via 3 × AA batteries (not included) or through a USB connection, making it easy to place anywhere in your home without worrying about trailing wires. Its colour-changing LED lights not only enhance the Snowman scene but also add a soothing, festive glow to your space. Whether given as a thoughtful gift or used to brighten your own Christmas decorations, The Snowman 29cm Water Lantern is a timeless piece that captures the joy and wonder of the festive season. Elegant, practical, and full of festive charm, it’s the perfect way to bring sparkle and magic into your holiday celebrations year after year.

Perfect size at 29cm tall, ideal for shelves, windowsills, mantelpieces, or festive table centrepieces, blending seamlessly into traditional or modern décor
